# Recovery Workbench — testing standards

**Context ID:** `CTX-TESTING-RWB-V2`
**Version:** 2.0, 16 November 2026
**Source:** Test Strategy v3, Test Cases v7, Regression Suite v6, Test Data Plan v3, Engineering
Practices v5, D-RCV-06/07/28/40/43/44.

## 1. Test levels and tools

| Level | Tool | Scope | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unit (backend) | JUnit 5, AssertJ, Mockito | Classes and services | 80% lines/branches on recovery packages |
| Unit (frontend) | Vitest, Testing Library | Components, hooks, utils | 80% on `src/modules/recovery/**` |
| Integration (backend) | Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers PostgreSQL (`recovery-it`) | Repository, service, migration, view | Pass before every MR that touches a migration or Flyway config |
| Contract | Spring Cloud Contract / OpenAPI schema test | API request/response | Pass on every API change |
| BDD / functional | Cucumber, Playwright | Journeys | Pass in SIT |
| API | REST Assured / Playwright API | Endpoints, security, errors | Pass in SIT |
| Performance | `RWB-TE-009` harness | p95, throughput, soak | Pass before release |
| Accessibility | axe + Playwright (`RWB-TE-010`) | All recovery screens | No serious/critical issue |
| Security | PDPA lint, dependency scan, ZAP baseline | Code, logs, images | Pass on every MR |
| Migration | `recoveryIntegrationTest` + lint | Naming, sequence, schema, apply/rollback | Pass before merge |
| View conformance | SQL test | 30 views compile, no FK to `public`, grants | Pass before merge |

## 2. Test data

- Synthetic data only, generated by the synthetic generator (RWB-E1-065).
- SIT uses masked data (RWB-TE-004); UAT uses masked data; no production data anywhere.
- Every test fixture carries a story key and a purpose; no real customer name, ID, phone or account.
- Personal data fields are classified; a test that needs one uses a generated value and asserts masking.
- Test databases are per-class or per-suite; no shared mutable database.
- Testcontainers PostgreSQL 16; `@Tag("recovery-it")`; fail (not skip) when Docker is absent in the
  recovery integration task (D-RCV-28 (3)).

## 3. Required test coverage per story

| Story type | Required evidence |
|---|---|
| User story with ACs | One test per AC, plus the happy path, one negative and one boundary |
| Engineering enabler | One test per business rule and test case in the story |
| Migration story | Apply on empty, apply on baseline, re-run, negative cases, lint |
| View story | Compile, grant, no-FK, dictionary row, boundary rule |
| Temporal story | Worker start, activity retry, deterministic replay, flag off |
| Drools story | Compile, scenario pass/fail, approval, effective date, rollback |
| API story | Contract, 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, idempotency |
| UI story | Component test, Playwright flow, accessibility scan, empty/error/loading states |

## 4. Gates

| Gate | Passes when | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Ready | Story complete; every AC can be tested; every rule/field/message ID exists | Analyst + tech lead |
| Spec | Requirement-to-SPEC coverage complete; no open ambiguity | Product Owner |
| Plan | Every file, test and migration named; one module | Tech lead |
| Merge | Unit + integration + contract + lint pass; named reviewer approves | Reviewer |
| SIT exit | Every test case for the release passes in SIT | QA lead |
| UAT exit | Business testers sign the UAT scripts | Business lead |
| Release | SIT and UAT exits met; unfinished work behind a flag that is off | Release owner |

## 5. Evidence and reporting

- Each run writes to `output/<RUN_ID>/`:
  - `specify/compliance-validation.md`
  - `plan/tests/scenarios.md`
  - `implement/unit-tests/report.md`
  - `implement/backend/*.log`, `coverage.log`, `recoveryCoverageReport.xml`
  - `implement/frontend/coverage-summary.json`, `lcov.info`, `check-*.log`
  - `api-tests/`, `functional-tests/`
  - `review/*.md`
- A test claim names the command, the environment and the result; no invented result.
- A failed test is reported as failed, with the failing assertion and the log path.
- A skipped test names the reason and the approval.

## 6. Coverage rules

- Backend: JaCoCo `recoveryCoverageReport` and `recoveryCoverageVerification`, 80% line and branch on
  recovery packages; test-scope boundary tooling included for RWB-TE-001.
- Frontend: Vitest `--coverage` with `@vitest/coverage-v8`, 80% on `src/modules/recovery/**`.
- A coverage report with 0 measurable statements is a PASS with the totals recorded, not a failure
  (D-RCV-43 (3)).
- Coverage is measured on changed code first; a global drop blocks the merge.

## 7. Special test rules from the 15–16 November baseline

| Rule | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|
| No inbound load test | Removed stories do not get tests; test the view instead | D-RCV-35 |
| View conformance | 30 views compile; no FK to `public`; grants correct; dictionary rows exist | ADR-010, E1-069 |
| Extension table uniqueness | Second row for an ACE key is refused with SQLSTATE 23505 | E1-069 |
| BND-6 | A recovery class naming a `public` table fails the build | E1-069 |
| Temporal determinism | Workflow replay test; no clock/random/I/O in workflow code | ADR-011, E2-040 |
| Drools scenarios | Minimum 50 per package; author cannot approve; rollback one call | D-RCV-36 |
| Flag-off path | With `rwb.p3.temporal` or `rwb.p3.drools` off, the previous path still works | D-RCV-36 |
| Migration lint | Name, sequence, header, no literal schema, no `SET search_path`, no `R__` | D-RCV-28 |
| Corrective migration | Next sequence, same story key, line 2 `-- Fix:` | D-RCV-28 |

## 8. Test environments

| Environment | Data | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| DEV | Synthetic | Build and unit/integration |
| SIT | Masked | System and functional |
| UAT | Masked | Business acceptance |
| PROD | Live | Smoke and monitoring only |

No test runs against a shared database with `clean` enabled. Flyway `clean` is disabled in every
environment.

## 9. Required guidance for test agents

1. Read the story and its spec; derive tests from ACs, business rules and exception paths.
2. Write the test before the code; a change with no test is not complete.
3. Use the message ID and exact wording; do not assert a paraphrase.
4. Cover the flag-off path for every Temporal/Drools story.
5. Record the command and the evidence path; never claim a pass without a log.
6. Do not test a removed story; test the replacement view or the new home named in the retirement
   register.
7. Record an assumption; do not ask a question during an automated stage.

## 10. N/A and evidence scope

- N/A — no production data or live database test; all tests use synthetic or masked data.
- N/A — no mobile app test; the Workbench is a responsive web module.
